scope.summary: Expose a variant-set instance's variant properties as switchable fields on the instance inspector; setting a variant property re-selects the member definition in place while preserving compatible overrides (MT-340). Runtime variant switching from a prototype interaction is the change-to action in 14.11 (MT-378) and reuses this switch path.
acceptance_criteria: instance exposes switchable variant fields; in-place member re-selection preserves compatible overrides
expected_tests: argus: instance inspector shows switchable variant-property fields via author_id
test: setting a variant property re-selects the member in place + preserves compatible overrides

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Switching instance variants

risk_if_missed: Instances cannot switch variants; interactive components (14.11) have no switch primitive.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
